球形 Hellinger-Kantorovich 流的稳定性及其对差分隐私的影响On the Stability of Spherical Hellinger-Kantorovich Flows and Their Implications for Differential Privacy

Aratrika Mustafi Soumya Mukherjee
摘要Abstract

梯度流采样将吉布斯分布解释为概率测量上的能量函数的最小值，并生成收敛到该目标的动态。在球形 Hellinger-Kantorovich (SHK) 几何结构下，流动与传递和反应耦合，并且与生灭朗之万动力学一致。在这项工作中，我们开发了 SHK 梯度流的扰动理论。对于两个电位Gradient-flow sampling interprets a Gibbs distribution as the minimizer of an energy functional over probability measures and generates dynamics converging to this target. Under spherical Hellinger-Kantorovich (SHK) geometry, the flow couples transport and reaction and coincides with birth-death Langevin dynamics. In this work, we develop a perturbation theory for SHK gradient flows. For two potentialsVV和andV′V^{\prime}我们比较常见初始化的相关流程，并量化潜在差异如何随时间传播。均匀的扰动界限产生对数似然比和 Rényi 散度的无量纲、逐点控制，而额外的结构也允许我们导出 KL 散度的界限。我们将这些结果应用于差分隐私中指数机制的近似采样。似然比控制为基于 SHK 的采样器提供了明确的时间相关的 Pure-DP 保证，而 KL 界限通过曲棍球棒散度产生近似 DP 证书。我们还推导了一个效用界限，将内在指数机制次优性与有限时间采样误差分开。we compare the associated flows from a common initialization and quantify how potential discrepancies propagate over time. A uniform perturbation bound yields dimension-free, pointwise control of the log-likelihood ratio and Rényi divergence, while additional structure allows us to derive bounds for the KL divergence as well. We apply these results to approximate sampling for the exponential mechanism in differential privacy. The likelihood-ratio control provides explicit time-dependent Pure-DP guarantees for SHK-based samplers, while the KL bound yields Approximate-DP certificates via hockey-stick divergence. We also derive a utility bound separating intrinsic exponential-mechanism suboptimality from finite-time sampling error.

1 简介Introduction

我们考虑从非标准化玻尔兹曼/吉布斯密度采样的问题，We consider the problem of sampling from an unnormalized Boltzmann/ Gibbs density,π​(θ)∝exp⁡(−V​(θ)),θ∈Θ⊂ℝd\pi(\theta)\ \propto\ \exp\big(-V(\theta)\big),\theta\in\Theta\subset\mathbb{R}^{d}，其中归一化常数未知（和/或难以处理）并且只有势函数, where the normalization constant is unknown (and/or intractable) and only the potential functionVV（通常是其衍生物）可以被评估。这个问题出现在贝叶斯推理、统计物理学和现代机器学习的各个领域。采样的常见变分视角是表征目标分布(and typically its derivatives) can be evaluated. This problem arises across various domains in Bayesian inference, statistical physics, and modern machine learning. A common variational perspective on sampling is to characterize the target distributionπ\pi作为概率测度空间上函数（通常是散度函数）的唯一最小化器。从这个角度来看，采样可以表述为演化初始分布as the unique minimizer of a functional (typically a divergence functional) over the space of probability measures. From this viewpoint, sampling can be formulated as evolving an initial distributionρ0\rho_{0}朝向towardπ\pi通过该函数在概率测度空间上适当的几何结构下的梯度流。via the gradient flow of this functional under a suitable geometric structure on the space of probability measures.

在本文中，我们重点关注基于球面 Hellinger Kantorovich (SHK)（也称为 Wasserstein Fisher Rao (WFR)）概率测度空间几何学构建的基于梯度流的采样方法In this paper, we focus on a gradient flow based sampling methodology built from the spherical Hellinger Kantorovich (SHK), also known as the Wasserstein Fisher Rao (WFR), geometry on the space of probability measures(Kondratyev and Vorotnikov, 2019; Liero et al., 2018; Chizat et al., 2015)。当变分目标是唯一 KL 散度时. When the variational objective is the exclusive KL divergenceρ↦KL⁡(ρ∥π)\rho\mapsto\operatorname{KL}(\rho\|\pi)，SHK 梯度流生成时间索引的边际族, the SHK gradient flow generates a time-indexed family of marginals{ρt}t≥0\{\rho_{t}\}_{t\geq 0}（初始化于(initialized atρ0∈𝒫2​(Θ)\rho_{0}\in\mathcal{P}_{2}(\Theta)）根据连续反应方程（) that evolves according to the continuity reaction equation (4）。这种演化相当于生灭朗之万动力学). This evolution is equivalent to the birth-death Langevin dynamics introduced inLu et al. (2019)。 SHK 几何结构应与经典 Wasserstein（又名 Kantorovich）几何结构进行对比 - 在后一种情况下，梯度流纯粹是基于传输的，并且对应于标准连续性方程（福克普朗克动力学）（. The SHK geometry should be contrasted with the classical Wasserstein (aka Kantorovich) geometry - In the latter case, the gradient flow is purely transport based and corresponds to the standard continuity equation (Fokker Planck dynamics) (3），而 SHK 梯度流通过反应分量增强输运，从而产生连续性反应方程，在具有挑战性的能源景观中，该方程导致相对于仅输运动力学的可证明的加速[参见部分), whereas the SHK gradient flow augments transport with a reaction component giving rise to a continuity reaction equation which leads to provable acceleration relative to the transport only dynamics in challenging energy landscapes [See Section3了解更多详情]。for more details].

这项工作的主要理论目标是量化基于 SHK 几何的采样器在电势扰动下的稳定性。具体来说，给定两个势The primary theoretical objective of this work is to quantify the stability of the SHK geometry based sampler under perturbations of the potential. 相关作品Related works

差分隐私与随机优化和基于扩散的采样有着广泛的交叉。 DP 的基础处理和基于高斯噪声的机制，以及 DP-SGD 等实际部署，激发了沿着随机动力学分析隐私损失The intersection of differential privacy with stochastic optimization and diffusion based sampling is extensive. Foundational treatments of DP and mechanisms based on Gaussian noise, together with practical deployments such as DP-SGD, motivate analyzing privacy loss along stochastic dynamics(Dwork and Roth, 2014; Abadi et al., 2016)。对于朗之万扩散和噪声梯度下降，. For Langevin diffusion and noisy gradient descent,(Chourasia et al., 2021; Altschuler and Talwar, 2022; Ganesh and Talwar, 2020; Ganesh et al., 2022)提供依赖于时间的隐私保证（包括基于 Rényi 散度的分析），并展示隐私风险如何微妙地依赖于运行时间、离散化和噪声结构。互补的工作将隐私损失与信息论量（例如相对熵）联系起来，并使用这样的界限来控制成员资格推断和其他信息提取风险provide time-dependent privacy guarantees (including Rényi-divergence based analyses) and show how privacy risk can depend delicately on runtime, discretization, and noise structure. A complementary line of work relates privacy loss to information-theoretic quantities such as relative entropy and uses such bounds to control membership-inference and other information-extraction risks(Melis et al., 2019; Mahloujifar et al., 2022; Wibisono et al., 2017)。在分析方面，通过热核界限、遍历理论和微扰方法研究了 Fokker-Planck 方程的稳定性和扩散之间的距离（及其不变测度）. On the analytical side, stability of Fokker-Planck equations and distances between diffusions (and their invariant measures) have been studied through heatkernel bounds, ergodicity theory, and perturbation methods(Mattingly et al., 2002; Pavliotis, 2014; Sanz-Alonso and Stuart, 2016; Bogachev et al., 2014, 2016)，通常与函数不等式和集中工具结合使用, often combined with functional inequalities and concentration tools(Bakry et al., 2014; Ledoux, 1999, 2001; Malrieu, 2001; Schlichting, 2019).

最接近我们的 DP 驱动的稳定性观点的是最近的工作Closest to our DP-motivated stability viewpoint is the recent work ofBorovykh et al. (2023)，导出具有可能各向异性扩散的 Langevin 型 SDE 的相对熵稳定性界限，并将其转换为, which derives relative entropy stability bounds for Langevin-type SDEs with possibly anisotropic diffusion and translates them into(ε,δ)(\varepsilon,\delta)-DP和成员推理保证；它还讨论了各向异性或矩阵值噪声和相关机制的隐私准确性权衡。 我们的工作超越了仅运输的朗之万流，对这些文献进行了补充；我们分析了生灭朗之万动力学，并建立了适合该几何形状的基于扰动的稳定性界限，然后我们专门为指数机制采样器获得差分隐私保证。-DP and membership inference guarantees; it also discusses privacy-accuracy tradeoffs for anisotropic or matrix-valued noise and related mechanisms. Our work complements this literature by moving beyond transport-only Langevin flows; we analyze the birth-death Langevin dynamics and establish perturbation-based stability bounds tailored to this geometry, which we then specialize to obtain differential privacy guarantees for exponential-mechanism samplers.

4 基于主要扰动的结果Main Perturbation based Results

5 差异隐私的应用Application to Differential Privacy

在本节中，我们尝试将之前的结果应用到差分隐私中。差异隐私将隐私形式化为在不同数据集上运行的随机机制的稳定性的分布式概念。如果一个机制对应于相邻数据集的输出度量保持一致接近，则该机制被称为差分私有的。这确保没有单个数据点可以显着影响发布的分布。两个数据集In this section, we try to apply the previous results in differential privacy. Differential privacy formalizes privacy as a distributional notion of stability for randomized mechanisms operating on different datasets. A mechanism is said to be differentially private if its output measures corresponding to neighboring datasets remain uniformly close. This ensures that no single data point can significantly influence the released distribution. Two datasetsDD和andD′D^{\prime}如果它们最多有一个人的数据不同，则称为相邻。are called neighboring if they differ in the data of at most one individual.

6 结论Conclusion

这项工作分析了 SHK/WFR 梯度流采样器的灵敏度，相当于生死加速朗之万动力学，并将其与潜在电位的扰动联系起来。核心贡献是由两个 SHK 流驱动的时间边际定律的非渐近扰动界限。This work analyzes the sensitivity of SHK/WFR gradient-flow samplers, equivalently, birth-death accelerated Langevin dynamics, and relates it to perturbations of the underlying potential. The central contribution is a nonasymptotic perturbation bound for the time-marginal laws generated by two SHK flows driven byVV和andV′V^{\prime}，从相同的初始密度开始。然后，这些稳定性陈述被直接转化为指数机制采样的差分隐私保证，这在不同领域都有实际应用。关于 SHK 梯度流的现有论文，例如, started from the same initial density. Then, these stability statements are translated directly into differential privacy guarantees for exponential-mechanism sampling, which has practical applications in diverse domains. Existing papers on SHK gradient flows such asLu et al. (2019)与 Kantorovich（Wasserstein）基于传输的 Langevin 动力学相比，已经令人信服地确立了由于反应项而获得的额外灵活性和加速度的优势。我们进行了一些玩具数值实验来测试扰动界限的有效性，并凭经验证明了扰动 SHK 流的稳定性already convincingly establish the advantages of the additional flexibility and acceleration gained due to the reaction term in comparison to Kantorovich (Wasserstein) transport-based Langevin dynamics. We perform some toy numerical experiments to test the validity of our perturbation bounds and empirically demonstrate the stability of perturbed SHK flows in SectionA.3附录。作为这项工作的自然延伸，人们可以尝试放松我们所做的假设并开发 Rényi-DP 或of the Appendix. As a natural extension to this work, one can try to relax the assumptions that we make and also develop Rényi-DP orff-基于 SHK 梯度流采样器的基于 DP 的保证。-DP based guarantees for SHK gradient flow based samplers.

A.3 实验Experiments

在本节中，我们讨论了一些实验，这些实验是为了验证我们基于理论扰动界限的结果而进行的，并讨论我们理论结果的不同方面。In this section, we discus some experiments that we performed to validate our theoretical perturbation bound based results and discuss different aspects of our theoretical results.

实验数值验证了一维环面的SHK微扰理论The experiments numerically validate the SHK perturbation theory on the one-dimensional torusΘ=[−π,π)\Theta=[-\pi,\pi)，一个符合主定理假设的紧凑无边界域。所有实验均在一维环面上进行, a compact boundaryless domain matching the assumptions of the main theorem. All experiments are run on the one-dimensional torusΘ=[−π,π)\Theta=[-\pi,\pi)使用周期性中点网格。对于一个网格using a periodic midpoint grid. For a grid withNN单元格，断点选择为cells, the breakpoints are chosen asxi=−π+(i+12)​Δ​x,Δ​x=2​πNx_{i}=-\pi+\left(i+\frac{1}{2}\right)\Delta x,\quad\Delta x=\frac{2\pi}{N}。吉布斯目标计算如下. The Gibbs targets are computed asπi=exp⁡(−Vi)∑jexp⁡(−Vj)​Δ​x,πi′=exp⁡(−Vi′)∑jexp⁡(−Vj′)​Δ​x\pi_{i}=\frac{\exp\left(-V_{i}\right)}{\sum_{j}\exp\left(-V_{j}\right)\Delta x},\quad\pi_{i}^{\prime}=\frac{\exp\left(-V_{i}^{\prime}\right)}{\sum_{j}\exp\left(-V_{j}^{\prime}\right)\Delta x}。数值求解的 SHK PDE 为. The SHK PDE solved numerically is∂tρt=∇⋅(∇ρt+ρt​∇V)−αt​ρt\partial_{t}\rho_{t}=\nabla\cdot\left(\nabla\rho_{t}+\rho_{t}\nabla V\right)-\alpha_{t}\rho_{t}, 其中, whereαt​(θ)=log⁡ρt​(θ)π​(θ)−𝔼ρt​[log⁡ρtπ]\alpha_{t}(\theta)=\log\frac{\rho_{t}(\theta)}{\pi(\theta)}-\mathbb{E}_{\rho_{t}}\left[\log\frac{\rho_{t}}{\pi}\right]。该求解器对 SHK 输运反应偏微分方程使用周期性有限体积离散化和 RK4 时间积分。有限体积部分离散 Fokker-Planck 输运项，并使用中心对数密度比逐点评估反应项。 PDE 不是使用离散粒子进行离散化和实现的，而是作为连续 SHK 流的直接数值 PDE 近似来实现，以便尽可能保持与我们的连续时间结果的对应性。. The solver uses a periodic finite-volume discretization and RK4 time integration for the SHK transport-reaction PDE. The finite-volume part discretizes the Fokker-Planck transport term, and the reaction term is evaluated pointwise using the centered log-density ratio. The PDEs are not discretized and implemented using discrete particles, but rather they are implemented as direct numerical PDE approximations to the continuum SHK flow so as to keep the correspondence to our continuous-time results as much as possible.

实验4：Experiment 4:

该实验将 SHK/WFR 与亚稳态双峰目标上的普通 Langevin/Fokker-Planck 流进行比较。目标是表明 SHK 的反应项可以更快地收敛到目标，从而改善隐私-效用故事的效用方面。基础电势为This experiment compares SHK/WFR against the ordinary Langevin/Fokker-Planck flow on a metastable bimodal target. The goal is to show that SHK’s reaction term can give much faster convergence to the target, which improves the utility side of the privacy-utility story. The base potential isV​(x)=2.5​(1−cos⁡(2​x))V(x)=2.5(1-\cos(2x))。扰动是. The perturbation isV′​(x)=V​(x)+0.35​sin⁡xV^{\prime}(x)=V(x)+0.35\sin x。实验演化出四种偏微分方程：SHK 流. The experiment evolves four PDEs: SHK flow underVV，SHK流量下, SHK flow underV′V^{\prime}, Langevin/Fokker-Planck 流下, Langevin/Fokker-Planck flow underVV和 Langevin/Fokker-Planck 流and Langevin/Fokker-Planck flow underV′V^{\prime}。实验结果如图所示. The experimental results are reported in Figure4.

At t=6t=6，SHK 逐点对数比为 0.362 ，低于 SHK 定理包络线 0.414，表明 SHK 定理界仍然有效且相当紧。在这个特定的扰动诊断中，SHK 和 Langevin 的稳定性相似，但 SHK 收敛到目标的速度要快得多，并且与吉布斯目标的 KL 散度值也要低得多，因为 SHK 达到了, the SHK pointwise log-ratio is 0.362 , below the SHK theorem envelope 0.414, demonstrating that the SHK theorem bound remains valid and reasonably tight. The stability of SHK and Langevin is similar in this particular perturbation diagnostic, but SHK converges to the target much faster and achieves a much lower value of the KL divergence from the Gibbs target as well, since SHK reachesK​L​(ρt∥π)=2.91×10−5KL\left(\rho_{t}\|\pi\right)=2.91\times 10^{-5}，而 Langevin 方法仍然停留在 0.371。这支持了 SHK 反应项的效用/收敛优势，即使在亚稳态双峰分布环境下也是如此。, whereas the Langevin method remains stuck at 0.371. This supports the utility/convergence advantage of the SHK reaction term, even in the context of metastable bimodal distribution landscape.
